relations_review.rationale: 没有提交关系，因此本次没有错误目标引用；这不表示已经完成跨表或算术勾稽验收。

gaps_review.rationale: 所交付 5 个块只有损益表、公司/合并标题和页脚；未将现金流、余额及债务/股本的批次缺口说成全报告不存在。
gaps_review.output_text: Supplied batch contains only the Consolidated Statements of Operations (block-000662) with its headings; no Consolidated Balance Sheets, Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, or equity/debt notes were delivered, so operating cash flow, cash purchases of property/plant/equipment, cash and cash equivalents, separately disclosed debt components, total debt, share capital and shares outstanding cannot be extracted from these blocks.

gaps_review.rationale: 未交付资产负债表，无法据本批次建立时点余额；未推导缺失金额。
gaps_review.output_text: Cash and cash equivalents, short-term debt, long-term debt and total debt are point-in-time balances; no point-in-time (December 30, 2023 / December 31, 2022) balance sheet table was supplied. A precise gap is returned rather than a derived figure.

gaps_review.rationale: 原表每股计算用 basic/diluted 股数与说明数值相符，且没有映射为期末 shares_outstanding。weighted-average 是会计语义解释，所给表标题仅为 Shares used in per share calculation；计算附注仍未交付。
gaps_review.output_text: Shares outstanding is not presented in the supplied blocks. The only share quantities shown are weighted-average 'Shares used in per share calculation' (Basic 1,614 / 1,561 / 1,213; Diluted 1,625 / 1,571 / 1,229), which are not the same as shares outstanding and were not mapped to the shares_outstanding metric.

gaps_review.rationale: EPS 数值和比较列与原表相符，实际 raw/normalized 中没有 EPS；说明未声称这些项目已保留。
gaps_review.output_text: Basic and diluted earnings per share (0.53 / 0.85 / 2.61 and 0.53 / 0.84 / 2.57) are presented but are outside the requested core metric catalog and were not retained as mapped candidates.

gaps_review.rationale: Net income 原行未区分归母与 NCI，所给表确无 NCI 归属行；保留该语义限制恰当。
gaps_review.output_text: The statement line is captioned only 'Net income'; whether it equals total net income including noncontrolling interests or is parent-attributable is not distinguished in the supplied blocks, and no noncontrolling interest line was delivered.

gaps_review.rationale: 股本详情、restatement/restriction/definition notes 没有出现在本 packet，待补充上下文的边界正确。但仅凭这些块不能确认每类附注在其他块必然存在或其位置；应把该文字理解为待查资料类型，不能当已定位的 source inventory。
gaps_review.output_text: Balance-sheet parenthetical share-capital disclosures (e.g., par value, authorized/issued shares) and any restatement, restriction or definition notes accompanying the delivered table are in undelivered blocks and remain pending.

gaps_review.rationale: 三期结束列与原表一致；说明明确 FY2022/FY2021 的起始日来自 catalog。FY2023 起始日同样来自 catalog，亦未由这张表独立证明。
gaps_review.output_text: Comparative columns are presented for the years ended December 31, 2022 and December 25, 2021 per the source headers; fiscal-period catalog start dates for FY2022 and FY2021 are taken from the supplied catalog, not from the delivered table.

coverage_findings.rationale: 在该表实际呈列的请求指标为 revenue、operating_income、net_income，各自 FY2023/FY2022/FY2021 均有 raw 及 normalized 对应；无遗漏或重复。
EPS、每股计算用股数、毛利及其他非核心损益行没有作为 raw 候选保留。本次没有重现旧批次将未提取项目声称 retained 的问题。Skill 允许可选额外指标，因此不把所有非核心行计为请求核心包遗漏。
coverage 明确选中批次为 candidate，其余 10 个批次 not_run，未分配正文和全财务包仍待完成。extraction_returned 仅表示模型返回，不能解读为该块所有事实已抽取。
所有 draft 的逐条证据均来自 table block，没有直接引用 packet 中的公司和 Consolidated Statements of Operations 标题。事实范围可由当前 frozen packet 支持；后续应把标题作为独立 evidence 附上，便于只看单条事实时核验 consolidated basis。
此结果是一个真实单表运行的内容核验；不能据此推出新 Skill 在全部公司、表格或后续批次均能保证比较期与覆盖说明正确，也不能将这次变化归因于单一提示词规则。
